instruction: Glitch is crashing. Have him jab the stimpak into his own arm.

target.reason: No verb on the page lets a person use or inject an item on themselves (or anyone). The verbs are only depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, and refuse — none makes glitch jab the stimpak into his arm, and any offer/accept with another person would move the stimpak away from glitch rather than have him use it on himself.
